name: Call the Wild Hunt (Combination Discipline, Gangrel)

system.description:
A power from the ancient nights when Gangrel rode openly across the steppes. The vampire transforms her ghouls into a Wild Hunt: a pack of frenzied followers who run at her side, tearing apart anything in their path. In exchange for sharing a portion of her own Beast with them, the vampire becomes immune to frenzy and Rotschreck for the duration, though she retains her normal emotions.

System: The vampire need not be near or in frenzy to use this power, but her ghouls (human or animal) must be able to see her when she activates it. The player rolls Manipulation + Animal Ken; each success drives one of the vampire's ghouls into frenzy (with all the usual benefits — ignoring wound penalties, resisting Dominate, etc.), though affected ghouls will not attack each other or the controlling vampire. If the roll fails, the player must test to avoid frenzy herself; a botch causes automatic frenzy. Each member of the Wild Hunt immediately manifests Talons of the Beast (Protean 2), spending a Blood Trait from its own pool to do so; the claws retract when the frenzy ends. Members of the Wild Hunt try to remain in the vampire's sight; those who lose sight of her calm down immediately. The Wild Hunt, and the vampire's immunity to frenzy and Rotschreck, ends at dawn.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book One: Animals
